title: santolina chamaecyparissus var. corsica
intro: Santolina chamaecyparissus var. corsica, commonly known as Corsican Gray Santolina, is a shrubby perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Corsican Gray Santolina include wound healing, skin protection, and relief from respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
